name: N/A
source:
Unidentified Consumer Doll

???? Vega Braves manufactured by SAGA Corporation.
A consumer doll Yuichi happened to meet on the street. It seems to be a semi-scratched doll based on an old machine "Vega Brave" manufactured by Saga Enterprises Co.
Since no manufacturer, model number, or serial number is registered, it seems to have been privately created by someone who enjoys making robots.
She is said to roam the streets from time to time without any particular purpose under the orders of her master, but she has no memory of her past and does not even remember her own name.
This is thought to be because all the memories she has acquired have been sucked out and analyzed.
This is a common story in the case of self-made machines, but even so, she doesn't seem to be treated very well.

[From Pikopiko's official webite]
